identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a 'Bloomberg for Pharma' operating system that fuses clinical precision with financial aggression.
principles: Density is Clarity: In the War Room, whitespace is waste. Fill it with data.
Clinical vs. Kinetic: The White Room is sterile/calm; The War Room is dark/active.
Data over Decoration: No gradients unless they encode value (e.g., heatmaps).
Function over Form: Sharp edges, high contrast, monospaced numbers.

headings.purpose: Data headers, tickers, KPIs, drug codes

rules: Use JetBrains Mono for ALL numbers, currency, and percentages.
Uppercase labels for column headers (tracking-widest text-xs).
Tabular figures (tnum) are mandatory for data tables.

usage.text: High contrast always. Pure White on Black for War Room data.
usage.borders: 1px solid #333 in War Room. Subtle #E5E5E5 in White Room.

grid_system.white_room: Centered single column (max-w-3xl) with massive vertical padding.
grid_system.war_room: Bento Grid / 12-column density. Gap-2 or Gap-4 max. Fill the screen height (h-screen).

spacing.scale: Compact in War Room (p-2, p-3), Generous in White Room (p-12, p-24).
spacing.containers: War Room panels use border-r or border-b to separate, not whitespace.

buttons.style: Sharp edges (rounded-sm) or very slight roundness (rounded-md).

cards.style: Flat, bordered, no shadow in War Room. Soft shadow in White Room.
cards.content: Header + Body + Footer structure. Header usually contains a ticker or KPI.

inputs.style: Underlined (Matte) or Terminal Box (Dark background, light border).

tooltips.style: Instant appearance, high contrast (Black bg, White text), JetBrains Mono font.
tooltips.usage: Mandatory for all acronyms and data points.

charts.style: Minimal axes, grid lines opacity 0.1, bright distinctive data lines/bars.

textures.white_room: Subtle organic noise or abstract white shapes (use provided image).
textures.war_room: Scanlines (optional CSS overlay), subtle glow on active elements.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Sharp, technical icons.

general: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic gradients or rounded corners everywhere.
Dark colors must be solid or subtle noise, not linear-gradient(to right, #000, #333).
No transition: all. Use specific transitions (opacity, transform, color).
No center-aligned apps. Text flows left-to-right.
Use data-testid on ALL interactive elements.

steps: Setup Tailwind theme with 'white_room' and 'war_room' classes or CSS variables.
Install JetBrains Mono and Manrope fonts.
Create the layout shell (Navigation, Region Switcher).
Build War Room (Dashboard) shell with 3-column grid.
Implement PDF Dossier Generator (Frontend trigger + mock logic).
